quranTranslation.text: And when Moses returned unto his people, angry and grieved, he said: Evil is that (course) which ye took after I had left you. Would ye hasten on the judgment of your Lord? And he cast down the tablets, and he seized his brother by the head, dragging him toward him. He said: Son of my mother! Lo! the folk did judge me weak and almost killed me. Oh, make not mine enemies to triumph over me and place me not among the evil-doers.

explanation.bs: Musa se vratio narodu svome srdit i ojađen – povratak ljudima.
explanation.en: Moses returned to his people, angry and grieved — a return to people.

quranTranslation.text: So when they went back to their father they said: O our father! The measure is denied us, so send with us our brother that we may obtain the measure, surely we will guard him well.

explanation.bs: Kad su se vratili ocu svome – povratak osobi.
explanation.en: When they returned to their father — a return to a person.

quranTranslation.text: How disbelieve ye in Allah when ye were dead and He gave life to you! Then He will give you death, then life again, and then unto Him ye will return.

explanation.bs: „Zatim ćete Njemu biti vraćeni“ – povratak Allahu.
explanation.en: “Then unto Him ye will return” — the return to Allah.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Kill no wild game while ye are on the pilgrimage. Whoso of you killeth it of set purpose he shall pay its forfeit in the equivalent of that which he hath killed, of domestic animals, the judge to be two men among you known for justice, (the forfeit) to be brought as an offering to the Ka'bah; or, for expiation, he shall feed poor persons, or the equivalent thereof in fasting, that he may taste the evil consequences of his deed. Allah forgiveth whatever (of this kind) may have happened in the past, but whoso relapseth, Allah will take retribution from him. Allah is Mighty, Able to Requite (the wrong).

explanation.bs: „A ko to ponovi, Allah će ga kazniti“ – عَادَ za ponavljanje zabranjenog.
explanation.en: “Whoso relapseth, Allah will take retribution from him” — عَادَ for repeating what is forbidden.

quranTranslation.text: We should have invented a lie against Allah if we returned to your religion after Allah hath rescued us from it. It is not for us to return to it unless Allah our Lord should (so) will. Our Lord comprehendeth all things in knowledge. In Allah do we put our trust. Our Lord! Decide with truth between us and our folk, for Thou art the best of those who make decision.

explanation.bs: „Već bismo o Allahu laž izmislili kad bismo se vratili u vašu vjeru“ – povratak napuštenom stanju.
explanation.en: “We should have invented a lie against Allah if we returned to your religion” — a return to a state once left.

quranTranslation.text: And for the moon We have appointed mansions till she return like an old shrivelled palm-leaf.

explanation.bs: Mjesec, dok ponovo ne postane kao stari suhi palmin prut – povratak ranijem obliku.
explanation.en: The moon, until it returns like the old date stalk — a return to an earlier shape.

quranTranslation.text: And (remember) when We did deliver you from Pharaoh's folk, who were afflicting you with dreadful torment, slaying your sons and sparing your women: that was a tremendous trial from your Lord.

explanation.bs: „I kad smo vas izbavili od faraonovih ljudi …“ – usporedi 7:141, isti događaj s أَنْجَى; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And (remember) when We did deliver you from Pharaoh's folk” — compare 7:141, the same event with أَنْجَى; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And, of Thy mercy, save us from the folk that disbelieve.

explanation.bs: „I izbavi nas Svojom milošću od naroda koji ne vjeruje.“ – molba; molbe za izbavljenje u zapovjednom načinu u Kur'anu dolaze ovim oblikom.
explanation.en: “And, of Thy mercy, save us from the folk that disbelieve.” — a prayer; the imperative prayers for deliverance in the Quran take this form.

quranTranslation.text: And (remember) when We did deliver you from Pharaoh's folk who were afflicting you with dreadful torment, slaughtering your sons and sparing your women. That was a tremendous trial from your Lord.

explanation.bs: „I kad smo vas izbavili od faraonovih ljudi …“ – isti događaj kao u 2:49, ovdje s أَنْجَيْنَاكُمْ.
explanation.en: “And (remember) when We did deliver you from Pharaoh's folk” — the same event as 2:49, here with أَنْجَيْنَاكُمْ.

quranTranslation.text: Say: Who delivereth you from the darkness of the land and the sea? Ye call upon Him humbly and in secret, (saying): If we are delivered from this (fear) we truly will be of the thankful.

explanation.bs: „Reci: ‚Ko vas izbavlja iz tmina kopna i mora?‘ … ‚Ako nas izbavi od ovoga …‘“ – oba oblika u jednom ajetu: يُنَجِّيكُمْ, zatim أَنْجَانَا.
explanation.en: “Say: Who delivereth you from the darkness of the land and the sea? … If we are delivered from this (fear)” — both forms in one ayah: يُنَجِّيكُمْ, then أَنْجَانَا.

quranTranslation.text: And hold fast, all of you together, to the cable of Allah, and do not separate. And remember Allah's favour unto you: How ye were enemies and He made friendship between your hearts so that ye became as brothers by His grace; and (how) ye were upon the brink of an abyss of fire, and He did save you from it. Thus Allah maketh clear His revelations unto you, that haply ye may be guided,

explanation.bs: „… a bili ste na rubu vatrene jame, pa vas je On iz nje izvukao …“ – izvučeni sa samog ruba, kako Njemu priliči; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “… and (how) ye were upon the brink of an abyss of fire, and He did save you from it” — pulled back from the very edge, as befits Him; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And if We will, We drown them, and there is no help for them, neither can they be saved;

explanation.bs: „Ako hoćemo, potopit ćemo ih, i niko im neće pomoći, niti će oni biti izvučeni“ – iz takvog bezizlaza niko drugi ne izvlači.
explanation.en: “And if We will, We drown them, and there is no help for them, neither can they be saved” — from such a predicament no one else pulls them out.

quranTranslation.text: And who shun vain conversation,

explanation.bs: „I koji se prazne priče klone“ – osobina vjernika; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And who shun vain conversation” — a trait of the believers; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Allah will not take you to task for that which is unintentional in your oaths. But He will take you to task for that which your hearts have garnered. Allah is Forgiving, Clement.

explanation.bs: „Allah vas neće kazniti za ono što je prazno u vašim zakletvama …“ – zakletva bez namjere, rečena iz navike, kako ar-Rāġib objašnjava.
explanation.en: “Allah will not take you to task for that which is unintentional in your oaths” — an oath without intent, said out of habit, as ar-Rāġib explains.

quranTranslation.text: There hear they never vain discourse, nor lying -

explanation.bs: „U njemu neće slušati prazne priče, ni laži“ – o Džennetu; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “There hear they never vain discourse, nor lying” — of Paradise; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: That is because Allah, He is the True, and that whereon they call instead of Him, it is the false, and because Allah, He is the High, the Great.

explanation.bs: „… Allah je Istina, a ono što mimo Njega prizivaju – to je neistina …“ – ar-Rāġib za značenje riječi navodi gotovo isti ajet 31:30.
explanation.en: “Allah, He is the True, and that whereon they call instead of Him, it is the false” — ar-Rāġib cites the near-identical 31:30 for the meaning of the word.

quranTranslation.text: And say: Truth hath come and falsehood hath vanished away. Lo! falsehood is ever bound to vanish.

explanation.bs: „… Došla je istina, a neistina je nestala …“ – ono što nema postojanosti ne opstaje.
explanation.en: “Truth hath come and falsehood hath vanished away” — what has no firmness does not last.

quranTranslation.text: And eat not up your property among yourselves in vanity, nor seek by it to gain the hearing of the judges that ye may knowingly devour a portion of the property of others wrongfully.

explanation.bs: „I ne jedite među sobom svoje imetke na ništavan način …“ – bāṭil u djelu, ne samo u riječi.
explanation.en: “And eat not up your property among yourselves in vanity [bāṭil]” — bāṭil in a deed, not only in a word.

quranTranslation.text: And when the prayer is ended, then disperse in the land and seek of Allah's bounty, and remember Allah much, that ye may be successful.

explanation.bs: „Kad je namaz okončan, idite po zemlji i nastojte steći od Allahove dobrote …“ – traženje s trudom onoga što je hvalevrijedno.
explanation.en: “And when the prayer is ended, then disperse in the land and seek of Allah's bounty” — earnest seeking of what is praiseworthy.

gloss.en: to strive for, to seek earnestly

quranTranslation.text: Aforetime they sought to cause sedition and raised difficulties for thee till the Truth came and the decree of Allah was made manifest, though they were loth.

explanation.bs: „Smutnju su tražili i ranije …“ – isti glagol za ono što je pokuđeno; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Aforetime they sought to cause sedition” — the same verb for a blameworthy end; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: to strive for, to seek earnestly

quranTranslation.text: Lo! your Lord is Allah Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days, then mounted He the Throne. He covereth the night with the day, which is in haste to follow it, and hath made the sun and the moon and the stars subservient by His command. His verily is all creation and commandment. Blessed be Allah, the Lord of the Worlds!

explanation.bs: Allah, kako Njemu priliči, prekriva jedno od noći i dana drugim, a ono ga hitro traži (yaṭlubuhu ḥaṯīṯan) – noć i dan se smjenjuju bez prestanka.
explanation.en: Allah, as befits Him, covers the one of night and day with the other, which seeks it swiftly (yaṭlubuhu ḥathīthan) — night and day following each other without pause.
